item.title: Marine forecast — 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
item.description:
NWS Forecast for: 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
Atlantic Ocean
Issued by: National Weather Service Gray/Portland, ME
Last Update: 6:48 am EDT Sep 8, 2026

Today: NW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming SW in the afternoon. A slight chance of showers between 8am and noon. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Tonight: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Increasing clouds. Seas around 1 ft.

Wednesday: ESE wind around 10 kt becoming SSE in the afternoon. Mostly cloudy. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Wednesday Night: S wind 15 to 20 kt, with gusts as high as 25 kt. Showers, mainly after midnight. Seas 3 ft building to 6 ft.

Thursday: SW wind 15 to 20 kt. Showers likely, mainly before 7am. Seas 5 to 6 ft.

Thursday Night: W wind around 10 kt becoming NW after midnight. Mostly cloudy. Seas 3 to 4 ft.

Friday: NW wind around 10 kt becoming W in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Friday Night: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Mostly clear. Seas around 2 ft.

Saturday: NNW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming SSE in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas around 2 ft.
